apps.name: OpenXRay
apps.subtitle: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. X-Ray engine on iOS (dev)
apps.localizedDescription: OpenXRay (S.T.A.L.K.E.R. X-Ray engine) ported to iOS. Development build for on-device testing. No renderer yet (Phase 4) and no bundled gamedata, so it will crash at launch until those land — the purpose is to bring up the device-log loop.

versions.localizedDescription: Pre-renderer dev build for device-log bring-up. Expect a launch crash.
